claims.claim: IREN identity/tradability is validated as NASDAQ ordinary shares under CIK 0001878848; FY2026 Form 10-K is the primary financial/operating authority and reports an unqualified audit opinion on FY2026 financial statements and internal control over financial reporting.

Current governance evidence is independently addressable from IREN corporate-governance documents: the board is required to have a Nasdaq-compliant independent majority, independent directors meet separately at least twice yearly, and Audit/Risk Committee members must satisfy Nasdaq and SEC independence requirements.
Current valuation evidence is separately sourced from the previously persisted independent market source and is not treated as issuer corroboration.

risks.risk: Issuer governance policies establish formal controls but do not by themselves prove long-duration stewardship quality or eliminate founder/control and capital-allocation risk.

unknowns.unknown: Realized Horizon 2-4 margins, current covenant headroom and future financing mix remain unobserved; treated as confidence/risk limitations rather than favorable assumptions.

claims.claim: FY2026 evidence supports strong demand and infrastructure positioning but mixed present economics: $707.0m revenue, $702.6m net loss, substantial cash, large capital commitments and material debt/equity financing requirements.

Microsoft Horizon 1 acceptance is realized execution evidence; Horizon 2-4 remain commissioning/acceptance dependent, so contracted ARR and contract value are not treated as current GAAP revenue or profit.
Governance policies support an adequate-to-strong formal oversight band, but evidence does not justify exceptional stewardship scoring.

thesisQuality.basis: Strong contracted hyperscaler demand, Horizon 1 acceptance and integrated power-to-compute footprint support a strong band; capital intensity and unproven full contract conversion cap the value below exceptional.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: Rapid AI-cloud expansion and liquidity are offset by FY2026 net loss, large commitments, debt and financing dependence, supporting mixed/unproven rather than strong operating economics.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: Independent market evidence shows a high enterprise value relative to trailing revenue; substantial AI optionality exists but present valuation requires meaningful future conversion, placing the factor at the low end of mixed/unproven.

catalystScore.basis: Horizon 2-4 commissioning/acceptance and conversion of contracted ARR are multiple material identifiable catalysts, with contractual windows extending into early Q2 2027.

governancePower.basis: Formal independent-board and audit/risk oversight requirements plus audited ICFR support an adequate-to-strong governance band, but limited evidence of long-duration capital-allocation outcomes prevents a higher score.

alignment2036.basis: Power, data-center and accelerated-compute infrastructure directly serve durable AI/critical digital-infrastructure demand across plausible long-duration scenarios.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: Power, data centers, compute and Mirantis software/support create several reusable layers and demand channels, though economics remain dominated by infrastructure deployment.

bottleneckControl.basis: Multi-gigawatt site pipeline and integrated power-to-compute capability participate in scarce power/data-center constraints; planned MW are not assumed to be financed, energized or productive.

scenarioRobustness.basis: Geographic and vendor diversification plus customer prepayments broaden resilience, while financing, commissioning and customer concentration keep material scenario dependence.

substitutionResilience.basis: Integrated infrastructure and qualification/commissioning create friction, but hyperscaler self-build and competing GPU-cloud providers remain credible substitutes.

supplyChainResilience.basis: Multiple GPU generations and OEM/vendor relationships provide redundancy, but the 10-K explicitly identifies constrained GPU/networking supply and limited supplier sets.

pricingPower.basis: Large contract value and tranche prepayments indicate some economic leverage, but comparable unit economics and realized margins are not disclosed, so durable pricing power remains unproven.

riskEvidence.basis: High capital commitments, $7.976b principal debt, covenant/secured-financing exposure, dilution risk, constrained hardware supply and commissioning/customer concentration create material downside even with strong liquidity and prepayments.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: Primary FY2026 SEC filing, issuer governance documents, independent current valuation and same-cycle Scout/Beta source-addressed assists cover all 12 components; remaining unknowns concern future realization rather than missing present evidence.

scoreRecord.thesis: IREN can convert scarce power and data-center capacity into an integrated AI-infrastructure platform with contracted hyperscaler demand, but value realization depends on disciplined financing, commissioning and margin conversion.
scoreRecord.keyRisk: Capital intensity, leverage, dilution, constrained hardware supply and customer/commissioning concentration can make headline contracted demand materially less valuable than expected.
scoreRecord.nextCatalyst: Acceptance and revenue conversion of Microsoft Horizon 2-4 tranches through contractual delivery/grace windows extending into early Q2 2027.

risks.risk: Financing and commissioning execution can delay or dilute conversion of contracted demand into per-share value.

unknowns.unknown: Future realized margins, covenant headroom and customer acceptance timing remain uncertain and are reflected conservatively in risk/confidence rather than treated as blockers.
